description: Sahur (ends at Fajr) and iftar (Maghrib) times for every day of this or the next Ramadan in a city, with the expected or announced first day and Eid al-Fitr.

asr.description: Asr juristic method. Default: Hanafi in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh and Afghanistan, else Shafii.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

method.description: Calculation method id from list_calculation_methods. Default: the method of the country's Islamic authority (MUIS, JAKIM, Diyanet, ...), else Muslim World League.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

name: get_ramadan_timetable
title: Ramadan timetable
